Author: Pankaj Purohit
Bench: Pankaj Purohit
 Office Notes, reports,
 orders or proceedings
1Sl.
 Date or directions and Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S  No  Registrar's order with  Signatures  WPCRL No.1234 of 2024  Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
1. Ms. Shumayla Zafri and Ms. Lubhna Jahan, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Kuldeep Singh Rawal, learned AGA assisted by Mrs. Meenakshi Sharma, learned Brief Holder for the State/respondents no.1.

By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has challenged the First Information Report No.0587 of 2023 dated 15.12.2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 471 of IPC registered with Police Station Kotwali, District Dehradun.

5. It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is a seller of the land to the informant, who claims to be the owner of the property in question on the basis of the will (annexure 2 to the writ petition) executed in his favour in the year 2011 by owner of the property late Vijay Kumar.

It is further contended that late Vijay Kumar expired in the year 2018; the property was sold by the petitioner on the basis of will executed in his favour in the year 2011.
6.

Per contra, leaned counsel for the respondent no.1/State vehemently argued that the will in question was forged document and on the basis of the forged document, the property in question was sold by the petitioner.

7. Having considered the submission made by learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact that petitioner is seller of the land on the basis of will, the veracity of that will has yet not been tested by any Civil Court, it cannot be said at this stage that the petitioner has sold the property by changing the document.

8. Issue notice to respondent no.2 returnable within six weeks.
9.
Steps to be taken within three days.

WPCRL/1234/2024 on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99246445/
1 10.
In the meantime, respondents may file their counter affidavits.

12. During the pendency of this writ petition, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner pursuant to the First Information Report No.0587 of 2023 dated 15.12.2023 under Sections 420,
467, 468 & 471 of IPC registered with Police Station Kotwali, District Dehradun.
13. Stay Appl. No.01 of 2024 stands disposed of.

(Pankaj Purohit, J.) 12.11.2024 Arti WPCRL/1234/2024 on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99246445/
